entries.1e85ae0cdde7fe91: Leveraging its strength as both a trading company and a company with a manufacturing division, it works to supply value-added products through closer ties with overseas suppliers and product development tailored to customer needs. It has production sites in three regions: Japan, the United States and China, and in the United States it also operates walnut, prune and almond orchards.
entries.2775cf9ddc193b7f: As its basic management policy, it aims to create new food culture and contribute to society by consistently providing customers with carefully selected, safe and secure foods from Japan and overseas. To this end, it intends to integrate three functions, namely stable procurement of high-quality ingredients, enhancing added value through processing, and strengthening its ability to respond to customer needs, and to pursue each of them further. Its medium- to long-term management strategy states that, as a specialized food trading company, it will focus on maintaining and expanding existing markets, developing new markets and new fields, and developing overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, and that, as a food processing manufacturer, it will advance the development of its own processed products, expansion of production capacity and rationalization. It will also work to strengthen its management foundation, including promoting DX such as renewal of core systems and strengthening human capital management.

entries.3011215bf8bf1c8b: It procures food ingredients domestically and overseas and sells them together with products processed and manufactured by its production subsidiaries. entries.46a8dad09eb0fced: Of revenue of ¥124,897 million for the fiscal year ended October 2025, Japan accounted for the majority at ¥108,381 million, with China at ¥9,969 million and the United States at ¥6,547 million. By product, dried fruits and canned goods were the largest at ¥44,763 million, followed by dairy products and oils and fats at ¥38,595 million, confectionery and retail products at ¥20,878 million and confectionery ingredients at ¥20,648 million. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.53abfbf1dcc9592a: This is a reportable segment in which Qingdao ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd. and Yanji ShoEi Foods Co., Ltd., the production bases in China, process and manufacture confectionery raw materials and dried fruits, export them to the company and sell them within China and Hong Kong. Shanghai ShoEi International Trade Co., Ltd. and Hong Kong Shoei International Trading Co., Ltd. mainly purchase dried fruits from overseas and are responsible for sales in China and Hong Kong. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥9,969 million.
